matches.description: Conceptual match (no literal DB signature hit: the DB signatures are BatchNFTMinter-specific). burn() pays the WHOLE accrued pot to msg.sender on a value-blind gate: holding >=1 unit of ANY tokenId. Payout is never compared to what the burner paid for the NFT (all tokenIds equal; NFTs minted cheaply via a low-price dispatcher or free via NFTMinterV2.mintFor by an authorized minter redeem identically). Pot is winner-takes-all per block, so any NFT holder/searcher can copy or back-run a pending burn (or the pauser's unpause / owner's setRatePerDay tx) and take the pot; the second burner in the block gets 0.
matchedConditions: full pot paid out on a non-value (hold-any-NFT) gate
payout not compared to the value the caller contributed
unmatchedConditions: recipient is msg.sender, not arbitrary caller-chosen (moot: attacker burns its own NFT)
no external mint/transfer loop before the pot read
mitigationsPresent: minPayout slippage floor reverts BEFORE the NFT burn (L101), so a front-run victim with minPayout>0 keeps the NFT and loses only gas
missingMitigations: minPayout=0 is a documented opt-out: a front-run victim using it burns its NFT for ~0
no ordering protection (commit-reveal / per-holder accrual) - by design
matches.triageContext: Story-053 Notes declare the pot 'trivially front-runnable' and add minPayout as the answer; pot is newly-minted Antimatter (memory externally-derived-yield-opportunity-cost-not-loss => misallocation, not value leak). Pattern note: permissionless front-run of a legitimately-funded pot is a valid MEV finding (Law 1). Expect Low/QA unless econ-scanner shows a victim-loss path beyond the minPayout=0 opt-out. Cross-contract value-blindness (mintFor free NFTs) DEFERRED to econ-scanner.

matches.description: Accrual continues across a window in which claims are impossible (paused), and maxPayout defaults to 0 = unlimited. A pause of N days (e.g. a global-Pauser incident) accrues ratePerDay*N into one pot that the first burner after unpause takes in a single Antimatter mint (Antimatter mint is uncapped/unpausable). The unpause tx is a deterministic MEV back-run target. The story states maxPayout exists to stop 'a long idle period from turning into one large mint', but the default leaves it off and pause does not checkpoint/freeze.
matchedConditions: emissions continue through a period where the claim window is closed (pause analogue of 'after windowEnd')
mitigationsPresent: maxPayout caps the pot when set (excess forfeited)
setRatePerDay(0) checkpoints and freezes accrual (documented economic lever)
missingMitigations: maxPayout not required when enabling a rate
pause does not checkpoint or stop accrual
matches.triageContext: Spec-conformant (story-053: 'Pause does not freeze accrual'). Law-3 footgun candidate: a competent owner pausing during an incident may be surprised the pot balloons into one back-runnable mint when maxPayout is unset. Duplicates profile LOCAL-001; safe-config guidance belongs on the phStaging2 deployment follow-up. Expect Low.

manualReview.description: phoenix-nft-staking ledger 858e9e80 (H-01 value-blind nudge gate, wont-fix) and the race 521c20ad rest on the run-21 premise 'the claim NFT has NO realizable redemption value'. NFTBonfire creates exactly such a value: any NFTMinterV2 claim NFT can now be burned for the accrued Antimatter pot. If BatchNFTMinter mints from the same NFTMinterV2 that NFTBonfire is authorized on, a nudge snatcher nets nudge pot + bonfire redemption, so the 'keep pot < nudgeSize*mintPrice' bound may no longer contain the gate. Depends on deployment wiring (phStaging2 follow-up, not landed) and Antimatter value vs pot.

mint( / IMintable hit. Single mint site (L108) mints exactly pendingPayout(), zeroed before the call; no second mint path; issuance bounded by ratePerDay*elapsed (and maxPayout per burn when set). Free mintFor NFTs redirect, not increase, issuance (folded into PATTERN-001).
nonReentrant on burn; CEI before both external calls; other writers onlyOwner; pendingPayout reads already-zeroed state during any callback.
No safe-mint; OZ 5.5 ERC1155._burn skips acceptance check (to==0).
block.timestamp is a linear accrual clock, not entropy.
'pending' matched only identifier pendingPayout; no two-step commit.
`cap != 0 && raw > cap` and `payout < minPayout` match documented semantics.
Single floor `/ 1 days` after multiply, protocol-favouring; <1 wei per checkpoint.
